个人文字、照片、声音和个人生活册默认保存在本机；未主动分享的个人内容不会上传到家: Private text, photos, audio and personal albums stay on this device by default. Private content you have not shared is not uploaded to the family service.
分享到家庭时，所选记录的文字、感受、日期及照片、声音副本会发送到家庭服务，供有资: Sharing to a family sends a copy of the selected moment, including text, feelings, dates, photos and audio, to the family service for eligible members to read.
家庭共享内容保存在服务器；阅读时，这台设备也可能缓存所需的内容和媒体。这不是每位: Shared family content is stored on the server. Reading may also cache content and media on this device. This does not give each member a complete family backup.
Apple账号与家庭身份: Apple sign-in and your family identity
个人记录不要求登录。使用家庭功能时，通过Apple登录，家庭服务会验证Apple: You do not need to sign in to keep private moments. Family features use Sign in with Apple; the family service verifies the Apple identifier and creates a Lampy account.
家庭服务保存账号标识、会话、昵称、家庭成员关系及分享记录。家庭身份不会自动绑定或: The family service stores account identifiers, sessions, nicknames, family memberships and shared moments. Your family identity does not automatically bind or move private moments on this device.
打开家庭或账号资料时，应用会连接家庭服务。服务也会处理用于访问控制和防止滥用的请: Opening family features or your profile connects to the family service. The service also processes request-source information for access control and abuse prevention.
当前家庭中的成员可以阅读仍有效的家庭分享，新加入的成员也可以阅读。家庭创建者可以: Current family members, including newly joined members, can read active shares. The family creator can organize them into family albums.
分享者可以撤回自己的分享。撤回后，重新联网核验的家庭阅读和家庭册不再显示该条记录: Authors can withdraw their shares. After an online access check, family reading and albums no longer show that content or media. Copies family members have kept outside the app cannot be remotely recalled.
离开家庭不等于撤回本人分享，也不等于删除账号。需要撤回的内容，请在离开前处理。: Leaving a family does not withdraw your shares or delete your account. Withdraw content before leaving if you want it removed.
在设置的个人资料中可以删除账号。删除前需要明确确认，并重新验证当前Apple身份: You can delete your account in your Settings profile. Deletion requires explicit confirmation and fresh Apple authorization. Transfer or dissolve families you manage that still have other members first.
删除账号会清除云端账号、本人分享及关联数据，并使所有会话失效；其他成员的记录保留: Deleting your account removes the server account, your shares and associated data, and invalidates every session. Other members' moments remain. Private moments and personal albums on this device are not deleted.
媒体在删除后不再通过家庭接口提供，并尝试删除服务器文件；失败时进入清理队列重试。: Deleted media is no longer available through family APIs. Server files are removed where possible; failures stay queued for retry. Families dissolved through family management follow a 30-day cleanup policy. Account deletion also closes and retires families managed only by you with no other active members.
删除时会尝试撤销Apple授权；如未能自动完成，应用会提示在系统设置中停止使用L: Deletion attempts to revoke Apple authorization. If that cannot complete automatically, the app explains how to stop using Lampy in system Settings. Registering again with the same Apple account does not restore the deleted family identity or content.
本机保管与当前版本范围: Keeping local records and this release
Lampy不提供私人记录的云备份或异常恢复服务。请自行保管本机记录；不要将家庭分: Lampy does not provide cloud backup or exceptional recovery for private moments. You are responsible for keeping your local records; family sharing is not a backup of your personal library.
1.0.0关闭购买、个人及家庭成品导出和打印入口。素纸、手作及纸页预览可以免费使: Version 1.0.0 has no purchase, personal or family export, or print entry points. Plain paper, handmade style and paper previews are free.
卸载应用通常会清掉本机私人记录和媒体。系统备份是否包含这些文件、以及能否恢复，取: Uninstalling the app usually removes local private moments and media. Whether system backups include or restore these files depends on the system and your backup settings; Lampy cannot guarantee it.
相机、相册和麦克风用于你选择的拍摄、选图和录音操作；拒绝权限时仍可留下文字。: Camera, photo-library and microphone permissions support the capture, photo selection and recording actions you choose. You can still write text if you deny them.
1.0.0每段新录音最多1分钟，到限会自动停止并保留草稿；已有的较长录音仍可播放: New recordings in 1.0.0 are limited to one minute each. They stop automatically at the limit and remain in your draft. Existing longer recordings still play.
在「回看」点右上角文字打开日历。有记录的日期显示条数，点日期阅读当天记录；点弹窗: Tap the text at the top right of Revisit to open the calendar. Dates with moments show their count; choose a date to read that day, or tap outside to close.
只有年份、月份或日期未知的记录不会被放进某一天，仍可从原时间目录查看。: Moments known only by year or month, or with an unknown date, are not assigned to a specific day. They remain available in the time directory.
在「我的生活册」切换「我的」和「家里的」。列表末尾的加号可以创建册子；编辑册子后: Switch between Mine and Family in My life albums. Use the plus at the end of the list to create an album. Edit and order moments, choose plain paper or handmade style, and preview the pages.
家庭创建者可以编辑和整理家庭册；普通成员可以阅读。分享者撤回记录后，家庭册不再显: Family creators can edit and organize family albums; members can read them. An author's withdrawn share is no longer shown in the album.
登录、分享与退出: Sign in, share and sign out
私人记录不需要登录。使用家庭时，通过Apple登录，设置昵称，再创建家庭或接受邀: Private moments do not require sign-in. For families, sign in with Apple, choose a nickname, then create a family or accept an invitation. Signing in does not automatically join a family.
只有主动分享到家庭的内容会上传。请在分享前确认内容和家庭；分享者可以撤回自己的记: Only content you actively share to a family is uploaded. Check the content and target family before sharing. Authors can withdraw their own shares.
退出登录只退出这台设备，不删除本机私人记录。离开家庭、撤回分享和删除账号是不同操: Signing out affects this device and does not delete local private moments. Leaving a family, withdrawing a share and deleting an account are separate actions.
删除账号与保管记录: Delete your account and keep your records
Lampy用于记录和回顾生活，提供本机私人记录、个人生活册，以及主动分享的家庭记: Lampy helps you record and revisit life through local private moments and personal albums, plus family shares and family album previews.
请仅分享你有权分享的内容，尊重家人的隐私和意愿；不得分享违法、侵权、骚扰或侵害他: Share only content you have the right to share, and respect your family's privacy and wishes. Do not share unlawful, infringing, harassing or otherwise harmful content.
